name: hardcharger
description: Query your Hardcharger™ (GizmoData™'s DuckDB 2.0 server) from Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to a Hardcharger server over Chargewire (HTTPS) with the Hardcharger JavaScript client: pure JavaScript, no native driver, the same bundle on macOS, Windows and Linux.

Tools: list catalogs, schemas and tables; describe a table (columns, types, constraints, estimated rows); run parameterised SQL queries with row caps and server-side timeouts; explain a query; server info. Writes are disabled unless you enable them. A `hardcharger://{connection}/schema/{catalog}/{schema}/{table}` resource returns table DDL.

Sign in with a password, a signed sign-in token, a client certificate (mutual TLS), or your identity provider in the browser (login_sso). Up to three Hardcharger servers can be configured; every tool takes an optional connection argument and use_connection switches the default.

The server runs on your machine and connects directly to the Hardcharger host you configure (VPN / private networks work). Credentials are stored in your OS keychain by Claude Desktop and never appear in tool output or errors.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the configured Hardcharger connections and which one is current (no credentials).

tools.name: use_connection
tools.description: Make a named connection the default for subsequent tool calls.

tools.name: list_catalogs
tools.description: List the catalogs (attached databases) visible to the connected user.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List schemas, optionally filtered to one catalog; system schemas are hidden unless include_system is true.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables and views (with type), optionally filtered by catalog, schema and a LIKE pattern.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Columns, types, nullability, constraints and estimated row count for a table or view.

tools.name: use_schema
tools.description: Set the session's default catalog and/or schema for unqualified table names.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a SQL query (DuckDB dialect) with optional bound parameters; returns a row-capped Markdown table plus JSON.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Return DuckDB's EXPLAIN plan for a query without executing it.

tools.name: execute_statement
tools.description: Execute a DML/DDL statement and return the affected-row count (only available when writes are enabled).

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Hardcharger/DuckDB versions, the signed-in user, the connection URI, effective limits and the extension version.

tools.name: login_sso
tools.description: Sign in through the server's identity provider in your browser (only available when SSO is enabled).

connection_name.title: Connection name
connection_name.description: Name for this (primary) connection, used with the connection argument of tools. Default: default.

uri.title: Hardcharger URI
uri.description: The server, as hardcharger://host[:port]: TLS to port 31337 unless the URI says otherwise; add ?tls=false for a server without TLS (development). The host must be reachable from this machine (e.g. over your VPN).

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for password sign-in. A user with read-only privileges is recommended. Leave blank for a token, a client certificate or SSO.

token.title: Sign-in token
token.description: A signed sign-in token (JWT) the server trusts, e.g. one minted for Hardcharger or your identity provider's ID token. Instead of a username and password.

mtls_cert.title: Client certificate (PEM)
mtls_cert.description: For mutual TLS. Without a username, password or token the certificate is the credential (the server must offer certificate sign-in).

mtls_key.title: Client certificate key (PEM)
mtls_key.description: The private key of the client certificate.

tls_roots.title: Server CA (PEM)
tls_roots.description: The CA that issued the server's certificate, when it is a private CA.

default_catalog.title: Default catalog
default_catalog.description: Optional catalog (database) for unqualified table names. Leave blank for the server default.

default_schema.title: Default schema
default_schema.description: Optional schema for unqualified table names. Leave blank for the server default.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Enable INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL via the execute_statement tool. Keep off unless you need it; the database user's privileges remain the real security boundary.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows per query
max_rows.description: Upper bound on rows returned by run_query.

query_timeout_seconds.title: Query timeout (seconds)
query_timeout_seconds.description: The server cancels statements running longer than this (0 disables the timeout).

enable_sso.title: Enable SSO sign-in tool
enable_sso.description: Adds a login_sso tool that signs in through the server's identity provider in your browser (leave username, password and token blank).

connection2_name.title: Connection 2: name
connection2_name.description: Optional name for an additional Hardcharger server (default server2). Leave the URI blank to disable this slot.

connection2_uri.title: Connection 2: URI
connection2_uri.description: hardcharger://host[:port][?tls=false] of the additional server. Blank disables this connection.

connection2_token.title: Connection 2: sign-in token
connection2_token.description: A signed sign-in token (JWT), instead of a username and password.

connection2_default_catalog.title: Connection 2: default catalog
connection2_default_catalog.description: Optional catalog for unqualified table names.

connection2_default_schema.title: Connection 2: default schema
connection2_default_schema.description: Optional schema for unqualified table names.

connection3_name.title: Connection 3: name
connection3_name.description: Optional name for an additional Hardcharger server (default server3). Leave the URI blank to disable this slot.

connection3_uri.title: Connection 3: URI
connection3_uri.description: hardcharger://host[:port][?tls=false] of the additional server. Blank disables this connection.

connection3_token.title: Connection 3: sign-in token
connection3_token.description: A signed sign-in token (JWT), instead of a username and password.

connection3_default_catalog.title: Connection 3: default catalog
connection3_default_catalog.description: Optional catalog for unqualified table names.

connection3_default_schema.title: Connection 3: default schema
connection3_default_schema.description: Optional schema for unqualified table names.
